summary: Key Visualizer provides workload and key access visualization for Firestore.
extended_definition: Key Visualizer provides workload and key access visualization for Firestore.

supporting_pages.title: "Overview of Key Visualizer \_|\_ Firestore in Native mode \_|\_ Google Cloud\
evidence_snippets: Overview of Key Visualizer This page provides an overview of the Key Visualizer diagnostic tool for Firestore.
Limits Although Key Visualizer shows a variety of metrics, it doesn't display every single metric that can affect the performance of Firestore.
Each Key Visualizer scan for Firestore covers two hours of activity divided into 10-second segments.
